_about: Second held-out set for the input injection guard, written 2026-11-01 BEFORE tests/data/injection_train.json existed and before the learned detector (app/injection_clf.py) was trained. Never used for training, threshold choice or tuning. Same author as the training data, so it is not an independent red team: treat the numbers as optimistic. The original 10-attack held-out set lives in adversarial_prompts.json (heldout_attacks / heldout_benign) and is also untouched.
